_provenance.purpose: Raw source records for the MiniMax model metadata backported into the project root opencode.jsonc. Snapshot only - do not edit.
backport_notes: Records come from the models.dev 'minimax-coding-plan' catalogue (MiniMax Token Plan subscription), which lists all-zero cost because the plan is prepaid rather than metered.
MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview is published only under minimax-coding-plan and minimax-cn-coding-plan; it is not in the pay-as-you-go 'minimax' catalogue.
The 'minimax-coding-plan' MiniMax-M3 record declares context 1048576, while the pay-as-you-go 'minimax' record declares 1000000. The backport uses the coding-plan value.
Capability backport only. Does not upgrade the OpenCode SDK/sampler, prompts or permissions.
Native maxima: M3 context 1048576 / output 512000, M3.1 context 1000000 / output 512000. Benchmark runs cap output at 32768 via runtime_opencode_model_limits.
reasoning_options is intentionally excluded: the pinned v1.18.3 provider model schema declares no such field.
interleaved is intentionally excluded: not declared upstream for these models.
cost.tiers is the only unsupported cost field in the pinned v1.18.3 model cost schema; context_over_200k IS supported. Neither is emitted, since the subscription catalogue carries no tier pricing.
